# Totenreich Easter Egg

**Totenreich Map![][image1]**

**Totenreich WW Steps**

1. Turn on Power and PAP

2. Activate the Crane by hitting the Green Button in the Building at the Dry Dock

3. A Wall will now suspend. Wall Run off of it and hold Interact at the Tip of the Ship to pick up the Chain

4. Pick up a Can of Chili at the Crates behind the Truck near Deadshot

   1. Place the Can of Chili on the Table at the Market Center

   2. Wait for a Special Round (Round 10\) and a Zursa will spawn. Kill the Zursa to pick up a Lantern

   3. Take the Lantern to the Burial Grounds Building and Interact with the left side of the Door to Repair it. You will need to hold Interact to repair it

   4. Once it is Repaired, go inside and place the Lantern down at the Center Table

   5. There will be Constellations on the Sides of the Table. You want to match those Constellations with what is on the wall by Interacting with them in the Order below LEFT, RIGHT, BACK, FRONT

      1. Example: If Dog is on the Left, then Interact with Dog first

   6. Astrid should spawn and you will need to follow her. She will periodically stop and you will need to kill Frozen Zombies. 

   7. Repeat this for a total of three times then go to the Lighthouse .You will need to do Parkour and eventually pick up the Jotun Star at the top of the Lighthouse

**Totenreich Easter Egg Steps**

1. First Uranium Canister

   1. Find Fishing Rods at either Dry Dock, Storm Bridge, Fishery Island, or Beacon Island

   2. Look for a Glowing Green fish that is jumping out of water and use the fishing rod (Can be at any POI) and look in the water

   3. Flip the round and run around the map and kill the Radiated Ravager for the first Uranium canister

2. Second Uranium Canister

   1. Go to the “Core Foundry” (right by the Red button in the WW step) and melee this Duct at the top of the stairs  with the WW

      

   2. Use an RC-XD through the hole and blow up the barrels to open up the Lab (Free one in Eidenskallen Square on a Crate)

   3. Go to the Lab by PAP and look outside the playable area at these Rooms. Pay attention to the numbers that have the Radioactive Symbol

   4. There are lettered Jars in the Lab that correspond with the numbers.  So A \= 1, B \= 2, and so on. Interact with two Jars that have your letters and place them on the Cabinet next to the Cell with two indents for the Jars

   5. There will be a Purple Serum that you can pick up. Place this on the Mutated Corpse on the Table for the Necrospike

   6. Take the Necrospike to the Jail Cell and unlock the lock. You will need to move the Key around until the Spring activates and hold it there until it releases. Repeat two more times and pick up the second Canister

3. Third Uranium Canister

   1. Call in the Glocke Drop on a horde of zombies. Kill the zombies that are suspended mid air for the final canister

4. Go to the Second Floor of the Lighthouse and pick up the Crowbar

5. Look around the map for four different White Boxes and interact on them to open it for a Bullet

   1. In the Core Foundry next to Sniper wall buy

   2. Behind the Boat in the bottom right corner of Dry Dock

   3. Room right before Admin Room in the War Factory

   4. At the end of the Fjord Road

6. Go to the Light House and place it in the Artillery Cannon facing Spawn, melee the Cannon with the WW to Shoot it

7. Go to Spawn, search the Robot Head and pick up the Signal Amplifier

8. Take the Amplifier to the Robot that you used to activate Power, climb it and put it in the Wall 

9. Look at the Lights and count how many times each flashes (Left and Right). There will be two sequences, so remember how many times each flashed during each sequence (Two Left, Two Right) for four total numbers

10. Go to the Radio Tower and Molotov the Zip Line to defrost it and climb up

11. Interact with the Control Panel and turn the dials to the codes you got from the flashing lights

    1. EX. First code you got was Left \= 7 and Right \= 2

    2. Rockets should shoot. If they hit the Radio Tower, move on to the next step. If not, repeat with the Second Set of Codes

    3. Sometimes you don’t have to do a Second Set of Codes. You just want the G Strike to Shoot the Radio Tower

    4. Pick up the Rocket Barrage Controller in the Room next to the Radio Tower. (If it isn’t there, you can Craft one)

    5. Go to Dry Dock and call in the Controller on this Wall

![][image2]

12. You will now play a Claw Game. You want to set down the Canisters from the left side of the Machine to the empty Slots on the right side. The goal is to get the Tick to match the Green Line

    1. You will need to be careful to connect the electrical current from Canister to Canister.

    2. Pick up the Uranium Core and place it on the Box directly to the right of Quick Revive. You will not be able to run

    3. Run to the Shack behind and activate the Generator on the Wall

    4. Do the Soul Box and protect the Core. You will need to reactivate the Generator periodically (about 3 times)

    5. Pick up the generator and then place it on the Barrel on the Bridge

    6. Wait for the mini-custscene to play. Once done, run to the Left side of the Bridge and pick up the Shard

    7. Take the Shard to the Fire Place in front of Vulture Aid and place it down

    8. Use a Charged WW shot to activate the Fire

    9. Use a Disciple Injection to heat up the Shard by throwing Zombies at it and take down the HVT that will Spawn

    10. Pick up the Shard then place it on the Altar of the Church

    11. Use a Charged WW Shot to Activate it

13. Look up at the Sky and Shoot these Arrows in the specific order pictured

14. Go to Fire Pits around the map and Light the Symbols (Runic Letters at the very Edge of the Circle pictured above) by using a Charged WW Shot (3 Total). Shoot them in the order displayed 

15. Go inside the Robot and active the Power Terminal to start the Boss Fight

# Paradox Junction Easter Egg

**Paradox Junction Easter Egg Steps**

5. **NUKEDTOWN**

   1. Kill 10 Zombies near the Yellow Spores to break them and get the Blundergat Stock. If you do not get it, repeat with other spores

   2. Pick up the Vial at the Desk on top of the Yellow House

   3. Interact with the Sink at the bottom of the Green House to fill the Vial

   4. Open doors to pick up the Trucker’s Key for PAP

   5. Listen to the Goo spots on the Walls. If one of them makes a noise, you can shortcut Step 2c and explode that wall first

      1. On the Wall of the Yellow Garage

      2. On the Wall at top of the Green Staircase

      3. The Wall to the Right of the Perk of Trinity Avenue

   6. Listen for a Mannequin making a ringing noise. You will need this for Step 3d. If you don’t hear one now, it is very likely it is where PAP is, which you don’t have yet unlocked. You will need to come back later

6. **CLEANTOWN**

   1. Turn on PAP

   2. Shoot the Swing Set behind the Yellow House and pick it up

   3. Throw Explosives to break the wall for the Blundergat Hammer

   4. Interact with the Mannequin from Step 1f

   5. Pick up the Sealant on the Bottom Shelf of the Bookcase in the Yellow House Upstairs Bed

7. **NUKEDTOWN**

   1. Pick up the Hammer from the Broken Wall in Step 2c

   2. Pick up the Part from the Mannequin in Step 2d

   3. Melee the Workbench in the Middle Truck and craft the Blundergat

   4. Pick up the RC-XD Remote (Round 8 or higher) and Blow up the Barrel in the Garage

      1. One location on the Shelf of the Yellow Garage

      2. Another on the Right of the Crate to the Right of PAP

      3. Last Behind the Fence in the Back of Green House

   5. Go inside the Garage and pick up the Chalk that Veytharion leaves

   6. Go back to the Swing Set behind Yellow House and Interact with it

   7. Go to the Yellow Garage and Interact with or around the Red Toolbox to pick up a Seed

   8. Find the Headset with Death Perception

      1. Behind the Trashcan on the ground at Spawn

      2. Shelf in top of the Green House

      3. Behind Yellow House Fence Area in Mannequin Hand next to Perk

   9. Find the Goggles

      1. Shoot the top of the Pole to the Left of the PAP Machine then have Wisp Tea activate to pick it up

   10. A Music Teacher will spawn once a round in the back of the Green House Garden Area. Wait a couple minutes if she does not spawn

   11. When she does spawn, you need to Brainrot or throw a Psyche Grenade to turn her. She will then go in the House and play the Piano

   12. Quickly teleport back to CLEANTOWN

8. **CLEANTOWN**

   1. Plant the Seed by the back left Red House at Trinity Street

   2. Fill it up with Blundergat Kills (Soulbox)

   3. Interact with the Toy Box at Trinity Street Twice

9. **NUKEDTOWN**

   1. Go back to the Tree and throw a Combat Axe Three times to pick up Firewood

   2. Locate 8 Music Notes around the Map (Image below) The order is denoted by how many times the notes blink. 1 blink represents first in the order, etc.

   3. Knock down a Ball by Shooting it

      1. Found on Roof of one of the Houses on Trinity Street

      2. On top of Stacked Boxes on Trinity Street

      3. On top of Yellow House Backyard Pillar

   4. Shoot the Ball and guide it to the X Behind the Green House Garage

   5. Start the Upgrade the Blundergat to the Sundergat **(You can do this later if you want, you will need it for the Sheet Music Soulbox)**

      1. At the beginning of every round a Zombie will spawn stuck in a Tornado. Walk up to it to release the zombie, then lead it to the Middle Truck and kill it

      2. Repeat this step two more times, with the third being a Shock Mimic. If you are struggling, wait to do this step at end of round

10. **CLEANTOWN**

    1. Go to the Yellow House and place the Firewood in the Fireplace. Then throw a molotov to light the Firewood on fire

    2. Play the Piano in this order: 86756535 (First note is far left, Eighth note is far right)

    3. Play a game of Four Square by Interacting with Ball from 5d

       1. The goal here is to not let the Ball bounce twice or out. With your MELEE WEAPON, keep hitting the Ball to another square to progress

       2. Kill Zombies with the Sundergat to move the Sheet music (you can do this at the very end too if you don’t have it yet)

    4. Melee the Truck Workbench and place the Blundergat to upgrade it (you will need to come back again in the PRESENT to pick it up)

11. **NUKEDTOWN**

    1. Go back to the Truck and pick up the Sundergat

    2. Go look at the X by the Big Driveway at Trinity Street and stand on it until it glows

    3. Locate Three Zombies outside the map and shoot them to harvest Souls (they are the right Zombies if they leave an Orb behind)

       1. In one instance, two Zombies were behind Yellow House, and the other was behind the Green House

12. **CLEANTOWN**

    1. Play Hopscotch at the Big Driveway from Step 7b

       1. The goal here is to jump from 1-12 in order, then back from 12-1 WITHOUT letting the Black Cloud touch you

          1. If you mess up, wait a minute or so and try it again

    2. Interact with the Toybox on Trinity Street and play Jacks (May need to interact with the ball instead)

       1. A bouncing ball will rise along with Zombies. When the ball bounces up, along with the Zombies, kill the Zombies before they hit the ground. Repeat for total of 5 times

       2. Kill Zombies with the Sundergat to move the Sheet music

13. **NUKEDTOWN**

    1. On top of the Green House, shoot the Individual Hands of the Clock to line them both up to the 0

    2. While you are Interacting with the Portal to go to the CLEANTOWN, shoot the Red Hand of the Clock. Some say doing this with the Sundergat is easier

14. **CLEANTOWN**

    1. Follow the Orb and Twins around the map for the Dialogue, go to the Piano in the Green House After

    2. Interact with the Twins at the Swing Set Behind the Yellow House to start Boss fight

15. BOSS FIGHT

    1. Phase 1: Clear three regular Spores, similar to how you got kills at the beginning of the game. One in the back yard of each house, then in Trinity Street. Follow the Twin Orb around and do Lockdowns. Once you are done the Lockdown then do ⅓ of the Boss Health

    2. Phase 2: Same as Phase 1 except you need to clear the Orbs similar to how you did it during PAP. Then another lockdown

    3. Phase 3: Lead the Fire Tornado Zombies to the Spores that you did in the Phase 1\. Then kill them with the Sundergat or a Bullet Weapon, and repeat for the final lockdown

# Astra Malorum Easter Egg

**Astra Malorum Easter Egg Steps**

16. Open up the Right Side Door that leads to Speed Cola. Go directly to the Left and Break the Display Case with the Hacksaw and pick it up

17. Turn on PAP. Feel free to Shoot Smoking Valves to Activate Telescope. Alternatively, wait until Step 5c for that

18. Wonder Weapon Parts

    1. Wires: Shoot a blinking Lamp Post anywhere around the Map

    2. Crystals: Get Cryofreeze and Shoot 3 Aetherium Crystals

    3. Battery: Shoot Tessie with a PAP Weapon

    4. Drone: Kill one of Oscar’s Flying Drones

19. Go Around the Map and look for 3 Sheets of Paper. Pay attention to the Planet and the Compass Direction and note it down. The planets appear to be static as Mars, Neptune, and Saturn, but the direction will change. This will be used for Step 9

    1. On top of the Desk in the Second Floor of Machina Astralis

    2. Desk in Electro Volt Trap Room by Jug

    3. On Middle Desk in Stamin-Up Room (same as Library)

20. Kill Oscar 3 Times with Traps to get the Wonder Weapon

    1. Electro Volt Projector Behind Jugg: Lead Oscar into the Room and hold Interact on the Trap Lever to deposit the items, then Activate the Trap. Fill up Battery Overcharge bar on the left

    2. Rocket Trap in Front of Speed Cola: Lead Oscar Behind the Rocket and Activate it

    3. Sun Beam in PAP Room: Activate Telescope then bring down Sun

       1. Shoot the smoking valves around the PAP Room. They will make a hissing noise. Keep repeating this until the Telescope makes a loud noise and activates. 

       2. Lead Oscar Close to the PAP Machine then Interact with the left side of the Organ to enter the Telescope Menu. Match the Telescope with the Sun and lead Oscar into the Laser Beam. 

          1. Also, feel free to zoom in on Mars and note the Coordinates that appear on the bottom left of your screen. This will be used for Step 6

    4. Pick up the Wonder Weapon when the Third Trap kills Oscar

21. Cryo Key Pickup and Brain Lockdown

    1. Sneak up behind Oscar, who will eventually cycle to an Audio Log of Thurston who says the names of 3 Planets. Note these down

    2. Translate the Planet names into a 3 Digit Code. The Code represents how many Planets it is away from the Sun. Look at code below

    3. Go to the Code Machine in the PAP Room, input the Code and grab the Cryo Key that appears by the Dead Body on the Platform that drops

    4. Go to the Body inside the Cryo Capsule at Machina Astralis and Interact with it. Interact once again to remove the Brain with the Hacksaw

    5. Take the Brain to the Container in front of Jug and survive a Lockdown 

    6. Pick the Brain back up, then deposit it on the Table in the Teleporter Room. Hold Interact again to attempt the portal

22. Locker Code in Teleporter Room

    1. Go to PAP and Interact with the Telescope on the left side of the Organ. Keep hovering over until you get to Mars and take note of the Coordinate Points on bottom left of your screen

    2. There is a Case/Locker on the Upper Floor of the Teleporter Room that you can Interact with and input the Code

23. Books in Stamin-Up Room Step 

    1. Go back to the Machine where you input the Brain in the Teleporter Room. It will cycle through Book Names. Take note of each Book Name

    2. There will be Statue Heads (also called Busts) you want to pay attention to. There are three Sections, with one Bust in each Section

    3. Interact with the Bookshelves and count however many times the names of your Books are listed in that Section. There are 3 Bookshelves per Section. 

       1. The books are static, so you can map your books to the example below without checking every shelf one by one

    4. You want to turn the Bust however many times your Books are listed in a Section. Repeat this step for all 3 Sections

       1. Note that you can only move the Busts at around the first 15-30 seconds of the round. Flip the round to do it, you will hear a noise that indicates it is ready

       2. For example, if you Interact on all the Shelves in an individual Section and only see one of your Books listed, you turn the Bust once

    5. A Ladder Hatch will open in the Library. Climb that Ladder and Interact to pick up Neptune Planet

24. Aligning Planets on the Planetarium in Machina Astralis

    1. Go to the top of the Machina Astralis and place down Neptune on the Planaterium. There should be an open Wire hanging down that you can Interact with on the top of the Stairs

    2. Shoot each respective Planet until they align with the Compass Direction shown on the edges of the Sun Chandelier. You will do this 3 times, one for each of the Papers you saw in Step 4

    3. For example, if I have Saturn SE, I will shoot Saturn until it aligns with the SE Compass Marker on the Sun Chandelier

    4. Interact with the Brain when you are done and do the lockdown. You need to prevent Flying Drones from entering the Portal. They make a very loud siren noise. Shoot them

25. Mars Snitch Artifact | Shooting Metal Orbs

    1. Teleport to Mars. Pick up the Brain in the middle of the area and place it on the top Machine by the Portal

    2. Hold Interact with the Brain until the step progresses

    3. You will hear a loud and sudden noise, indicating a Bird has appeared. There are 4 Metal Orbs you need to Shoot outside the map. Follow the order below. 

       1. Back Right, Back Left, Front Right, Front Left. See image below

       

       

       

       

       

       

       

       

       

     


    4. The Orbs should glow up if you are doing it correctly. If you are not seeing it glow, then you need to wait a new round and Interact with the Brain again to get the sound to reappear

    5. Then keep shooting the same looking Metal Orb above the Portal in the Map and keep the bird in place

    6. Keep doing this until anti gravity hits. The bird will eventually swoop down. Jump through it and Interact to complete the step and pick up the Artifact

    7. Place the Artifact in the Statue at the Back Right

26. Mars Symbols Step | Shoot the Top of 5 Pillars with the WW

    1. Interact with Organ at PAP 

    2. 4 Symbols will flash on the Circular Screen on the Right of the Organ. Take note of this. It plays a melody that has a clear beginning and end. There will be static in a random position as well, pay attention to that

    3. Use the picture below as an example code. There are 5 Symbols on Mars, while your Code only has 4 Symbols. The Static means that the 5th Symbol gets inserted in that Position.

    4. Go back to Mars. You will see 5 Pillars that carry the Symbols on them. With the WW,  Shoot the Top of the Pillars. 

       1. The order does not matter here, but I would recommend you Shoot them in the order of your respective Code to get a bit of familiarity for the next step.

27. Final Step Before Boss | Interact with the Bottom of each of the Pillars 

    1. This step is on a timer so be mindful

    2. Interact with the Symbol that appears on the Bottom of each Pillar, in order of your original Code

    3. The Symbol will turn Blue if done correctly. It will turn Red if done incorrectly, but you get 3 Fails before you have to progress a Round

    4. Interact with the Brain to start the Fight

28. Boss Tips

    1. For the First Phase, you will run around with your gun and charge Generators on either side of the Temple. Once it is charged, hold Interact with the Brain to start shooting Lasers. Repeat the process for every 1/3rd of Boss’ Health

    2. Second Phase is pretty simple. Just make sure to shoot the armor off then the crit spots for big damage

    3. Third Phase is similar. Wall jump and take advantage of low gravity to dodge the Rocks

    4. Final Phase is a bit tricky. I am working on tips for here

# AOTD Easter Egg

**Ashes of the Damned Map**

**Ashes of the Damned Recommended Order of Easter Egg Steps**

29. Turn on Power in Blackwater and pick up a Jar on the Kitchen Counter in the Cabin

30. Turn on Power in Farm and interact with the Horse that is glowing red on the road directly to the left of the Barn

31. In the Barn, use a Combat Axe and aim toward the Ankle of the Hanging Body in the middle of the room, follow up with a Molotov to burn the Ankle and collect the Bones

    1. You can find a Combat Axe in the Diner or in Blackwater Cabin

32. Turn on Power in Ashwood, get PAP, and quickly visit Klaus’ Jail Room

33. Go to Farm on the Ravager Round and use the Saw Trap on a Ravager to pick up the Eyes

    1. You can also move this to after Step 10 or after Step 20 if you want. Just do it on any Ravager round to make it easy

34. Go to the Horse that is glowing red and pick up the Widow’s Lantern after 3 rounds of waiting

35. Go to the Diner and keep killing zombies until you get a Freezer Key, once you get the Key, go open up the Freezer in the corner to get the Abomination Carcass

36. Go to Tessie’s Garage in Ashwood and upgrade Tessie to get the Abomination Beam

37. Go anywhere in The Fog and look for Purple Plants, use the Abomination Beam to explode the Plant and pick up the Flesh

38. Go to Spawn and kill the Uber Klaus whenever you have PAP Level 1 to pick up the Card

    1. He spawns from the Project Janus container toward the Blackwater Gate

39. Go to Klaus’ Jail Room and interact with the Terminal, throw 2 Stun Grenades to wake him up

40. Take Klaus to the Bottom of the Cosmodrome (use your Tactical Button) and guide him to the Control Switch to the right of the Glass Canister, then interact with it

41. Stay in the Red Circle on the ground and look up at the Security Camera scanning you, then pick up the Canister

42. Drive back to Ashwood and install the Canister in the Power Generator and then defend it while it charges

43. Drive to Blackwater Lake and repeat the same process with charging it in the Power Generator, then do the same exact thing in Farm

44. Go to the bottom of the Barn and install the Canister in the Cube

45. Use the Jump Pad to go from Spawn to Farm and pay attention to the three red symbols that appear on the top of the Roofs

46. Interact with the Cube in the bottom of the Barn and make the three sides of the Cube show the symbols you saw in the last step

47. Pick up the Gauntlet and shoot the Cysts with your Primary Fire, then recall your shots with your Alternate Fire (reload might also work?), repeat for all 6 Cysts to get the Wonder Weapon 

48.  Go to the Mirror in Ashwood, use Wisp Tea perk near it and then use the Wonder Weapon on the Mirror to pick up the Powder

49.  On Round 16, kill Zursa with Tessie’s Abomination Beam to get the Limbs

50.  Go to Yuri’s Lab in the Cosmodrome, interact with the Powder on the Dish and decipher the Cipher on the wall using the picture below. Interact with the 3 Items in order from top to bottom

51.  Start the Blood Ritual by interacting with the Vial in the middle, then Interact on the same spot again after the Ritual is over

    1. The ritual is difficult, so make sure you have high tier PAP, good weapon rarity, perks, tier 3 armor, etc.

52.  Look around the map for 3 Keys that will be in or near The Fog: you will see a colored glow that corresponds to the color. Shoot the Key with the Wonder Weapon, and use your Alternate Fire to explode the Barb and get the Key

    1. Red Key: Orda Graveyard, Deposit in Ashwood Cube when done

       1. Orda Graveyard Dinosaur Skull in Ashwood/115 Diner Area; 

       2. Also in the other Dinosaur Skull closer to the ground (back of the mouth toward the Neckbone)

       3. Walk from Diner to Orda Graveyard, hug right hand side, and look behind the right Project Janus vehicle

    2. Yellow Key: Crashed Rocket, Deposit in Ashwood Cube when done

       1. Between Ashwood and Cosmodrome, look up at the top of the fallen Radio Tower

       2. Directly as you exit Cosmodrome, look at the Building to your left hand side and it is right near the Radar

       3. Enter from Ashwood into the Crashed Rocket area (same as last step) look high up and left onto the rocks

    3. Green Key: Terminus Boat, deposit in Ashwood Cube when done

       1. Terminus Boat inside slightly opened Blue Container 

       2. Window in top of Boat

       3. Under the Boat, to the left of the two Silver Barrels

53.  Pick up the Turret Upgrade for Tessie and shoot the Ashwood Clock Face that now appears in the air 

54.  Shoot the Clock Face with your Wonder Weapon and use Alternate Fire to recall the shot, this will be known as going Purple

55.  While your gun is Purple, go to the Cosmodrome and shoot one of the spinning Satellites, repeat this step for the other spinning Satellite

    1. Shoot the other face of the clock to go Purple again

56.  In Cosmodrome, go to the Control Room and look on the right side Computers to look for a 6-letter Code Word

    

    

    

    

    

  


57.  Using the pattern of A=0, B=1, C=2 and so on, input each letter of the Code Word to match the number on the TV Screens on top of the room. Shoot the Red Button on the bottom right of the screen to lock in the number

58.  Interact with the middle Button to launch the Rocket 

59.  Go to the Diner and wait for the map to show Lightning (wait a few rounds if it does not show), then Turn the Wonder Weapon Purple again and shoot the Clock above the Diner to freeze the Lightning

60.  Revive 3 Zombies while the Lightning is frozen (if you are in Co-op, have one player handle each Zombie, so you can do it in 1 round)

    1. Red Zombie: Use Tessie’s Abomination Beam to hit back of Red Container to open it, then ram into it

    2. Yellow Zombie: Use Klaus in the Workshop and direct him to the dead Zombie on the ground next to the Car

    3. Purple Zombie: Use Gun Butt Melee on the Cash Register in the Diner

61.  Lead each respective Zombie color to their respective Lightning color one at a time, repeat the step two more times

62. Turn the Wonder Weapon Purple again and go to the Dining Room in the Farm House. 

63.  Look at the Hour Hand on the Clock on the wall and stand at that corresponding Roman Numeral on the ground next to the Table. Wait for the head of the table to look at you and shoot him when his eyes turn Red

64.  Pick up the 4 Artifacts and place them at the Red Circles outside to then defend them (don’t let Zombies hit them)

    1. Teddy Bear in the Cabinet to the right of Stamin-Up

    2. Cup in the Bathtub where the Cube is

    3. Pigsticker on the Table in Shed where Mystery Box is

    4. Face in the back left corner of Barn

65. Go to Blackwater Lake and interact with the Blue Soul on the Dock

66.  Turn the Wonder Weapon Purple again and go to the Blackwater Cabin and shoot the Projector. Memorize the four directions on the screen: Front, Left, Right, Back

67.  Find the Projector Reels in those locations and Shoot the Reels with the Wonder Weapon in order of the Projector from last step

    1. Front: Go up the stairs by the Power Switch, it’s tucked away at the edge on the Shelf

    2. Left: Go to the little Hut to the left and look at the Shelf outside

    3. Right: go to the right side Hut and look at the torn Ceiling

    4. Back: Look under the Stairs in the back right by the Ammo Cache

68. Hold Interact on the Foot of the Bed where Speed Cola is, then summon Klaus to the Box there, where he will then go to the back of the House and you can start the final encounter

69.  Go to Tessie and drive around the map to collect Wisps: these will look like the Red Spores that explode but they have a White Smoke around them. You want to run into them with this pathing (doing a big loop)

    1. Pick up 3 Wisps on the way from Blackwater to Spawn

    2. Then 3 from Spawn to Farm, 

    3. Then 3 from Farm into Ashwood

    4. Then 3 from Ashwood to Blackwater 

    5. Feel free to break off this path if you can’t find souls

70.  Collect all within the time period and get transported to the Boss Fight

71. Boss Tips

    1. Bring in Gobblegum that help regenerate your Armor and revive teammates to keep perks

    2. Use Tessie OFTEN: Have at least one person stay inside Tessie for the whole fight to ram into the boss

72. Whenever you see the Boss go immune, run into Purple Energy with Tessie, then run into the Boss

73. At around half health, the boss will do a Charged Beam attack that will one shot you. Have the person inside Tessie run into the Boss’ Eye that charges up. Have everyone else hide behind a pillar

74. **DO NOT EXIT AFTER BEATING THE EASTER EGG. WALK TO THE DOCKS SO YOU CAN INTERACT WITH THE RELIC TO UNLOCK THE RELICS IN CURSED**

# Astra Malorum Relics

**Astra Malorum Tier 1 Relics**  
**Tier 1 Reward: Golden Armor**

**A lot of this information is subject to change. I am trying to compile information from what I’ve seen online**

**Seed | Mystery Box is Disabled**

75. Get to Round 20

76. There will be a Grey Pistol that spawns somewhere around the map. Pick it up and get **EXACTLY** 20 Kills (That is what I’ve heard, don’t know if it is true)

77. End the Round with any other Weapon

78. Go to the PAP Room to start the Ritual

# AOTD Relics

**Ashes of the Damned Tier 1 Relics**  
**Tier 1 Reward: Golden Armor**

**Dragon Wings | Normal Power-Up Spawns are Disabled**

79. Get to Round 20

80. Take the Jump Pad from Farm to Spawn, and Shoot the 3 Purple Symbols in the air on the Buildings in Spawn

81. Go to the Relic Portal at the side of the Barn to start the Ritual

    

**Lawyer’s Pen | Mimic Props Have Infiltrated the Map**

1. Get to Round 20

2. Either throw Molotovs or shoot with Napalm Burst 3 Red Candles around the Map 

   1. In the Barn between Ashwood and Blackwater, on the Table by the Couch

   2. In Jugg room, on a shelf above the Couch

   3. In the Stamin-Up room at the House in Farm,camo on the Shelf to the left of the Bed 

3. Go to the Relic Portal at the side of the House in Farm to start the Ritual

**Samantha’s Teddy Bear | Round Delay Reduced by 75%**

1. While in Aether Shroud, collect 10 Mr. Peeks dolls around the map with the Necrofluid Gauntlet before the shroud ends.

   1. Blackwater Lake in the Toilet outside playable area next to Speed Cola

   2. Lost Cabins in the Fog outside of Blackwater Lake on the top right corner of a Log Cabin

   3. Grounded Ship on the Top Railing below the Deck (to the left and above the Blue Key location on the main Easter Egg)

   4. Large Silo behind the Barn in Farm, on the ledge

   5. Support Systems in Cosmodrome outside the playable area, on top of the Box System

   6. Ashwood above the Broken Roof (Church)

   7. Ruby Rabbit in Ashwood, behind the Stairs in Jump Pad area 

   8. Janus Towers Plaza on the top left of the Gate that leads to Blackwater

   9. Cosmodrome on top of an Electric Line Pole

   10. Get to round 20 then go to Exit 115, on top of the Broken Roof

2. Go to the Relic Portal at side of the Shack in Farm to start the Ritual

**Ashes of the Damned Tier 2 Relics**  
**Tier 2 Reward: Ultra Weapon Rarity**

**Vril Sphere | Players Can Only Carry 4 Perks**

1. Have the first 3 Relics equipped to activate Tier 1 Cursed

2. Get to Round 40 and wait for Doppleghasts to spawn in, then launch a Jump Pad while the Doppleghast is on to get it flying

3. Go to the Relic Portal at the Rocket in Cosmodrome to start the Ritual

   1. Purchases are disabled, so make sure you are ready with Ammo

**Focusing Stone | No Self-Revive Kits**

1. Have the first 3 Relics equipped to activate Tier 1 Cursed and then get to Round 40

2. Get  2 Wine Bottles

   1. Melee a Zursa to death

   2. Get Legendary Reward status at a Tedd Task

3. Go to the Cabin in Blackwater Lake and place the Bottles on the Table. You will see the Bottles break in a specific order and then respawn. Shoot the Bottles in the order that they broke

4. Go to the Relic Portal under the Rocket in Cosmodrome to start the Ritual

**Samantha’s Drawing | (Placeholder)**

1. I will update this when more information is found

**Ashes of the Damned Tier 3 Relics**  
**Tier 3 Reward: Tier IV Pack**

**Blood Vials | All Augments are Disabled**

1. Have enough Relics equipped to activate Tier 2 Cursed

2. Get to Round 20 and a Telephone will start ringing around the map. There are around 10 Locations and you need to spam Interact until it stops ringing. After every 10 rounds (Round 30, 40, 50, and 60\) you will hear another ring. Repeat steps until Round 60 and you will hear a Mr. Peaks laugh

   1. Server Room in Spawn

   2. Zarya Cosmodrome in Control Room

   3. Toolshed in Blackwater

   4. Bottom floor of Farm House on Table

   5. Hargrove’s Mercantile in Ashwood (upper Ashwood)

   6. Market Square opposite of Ashwood

   7. Service Station in Exit 115

   8. Behind Counter in the actual Diner

   9. Lost Cabins in the Fog between Ashwood and Blackwater

3. Go to the Relic Portal at the Blackwater Cabin to start the Ritual

**Bus | Enemy Health Regenerates**

1. Have enough Relics equipped to unlock Tier 2 Cursed and get to Round 60+

   1. For the Ritual, you can only use Brainrot to kill other Zombies, so have the augments leveled up and equipped. I have heard that Caustic Fumes and Explosive / Super Serum are good

2. Complete one round without taking damage

   1. Use Saw Trap on Ravager Round to make it easy

3. Go to the Relic Portal at Blackwater Lake to start the Ritual

**Dragon | All Ammo Crates are Disabled**

1. Have enough Relics equipped to activate Tier 2 Cursed and get to Round 60+

2. Beat the Easter Egg at Round 60+ and **HIT CONTINUE**

   1. If you are on Solo, you can cheese this by beating the Easter Egg before Round 60, save and quit, then reload the game at Round 60

3. Go to the Relic Portal at Blackwater Lake to start the Ritual

   1. Zombies can only be damaged by explosives, use Lethals, Tacticals, and the Wonder Weapon Alternative Fire
